headline: Margins lag expectation; healthy demand traction intact

highlights: EIM’s growth buoyancy is likely to continue, fueled by the trend of healthy bookings (growing at double-digits), modular capacity expansion and low channel inventory.
Retain BUY, with an SoTP-based unchanged TP of INR 9,000, valuing RE at 30x Sep’28E EPS and VECV at 10x EV/EBITDA.
Q2FY27: Margins below estimate EIM reported standalone revenue of ~INR 71.6bn (+21% YoY/+15% QoQ), broadly in line with I-Sec’s estimate.
EBITDA came in at ~INR 16.7bn (+14% YoY/+11% QoQ), 6% below I-Sec’s estimate.
valuation: Retain BUY, with an SoTP-based unchanged TP of INR 9,000, valuing RE at 30x Sep’28E EPS and VECV at 10x EV/EBITDA.
The views and opinions expressed in this document may or may not match or may be contrary with the views, estimates, rating, and target price of the Retail Research.
watch: Domestic outlook Management indicated that demand traction for RE’s motorcycles in the domestic market remains robust, with bookings growing at healthy double digits.
Export outlook EIM indicated that growth remains healthy in markets such as Brazil and LATAM.
